params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

params.name: pipeline_id
params.description: Opaque Pipeline ID with the `pipeline_` prefix.

params.name: pipeline_stage_id
params.description: Opaque Pipeline stage ID with the `stage_` prefix.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Opaque Account ID with the `account_` prefix.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Opaque Contact ID with the `contact_` prefix.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: relationship
params.description: Filter by owner relationship. Use `owner:user_...` for owned records or `owner:none` for unowned records.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of Deals. Supports filtering by `pipeline_id`, `pipeline_stage_id`, `account_id`, free-text `search` across Deal names, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`.

Create a new Deal linked to an Account and a Pipeline stage. If no `pipeline_id` is provided, the organization's default Pipeline is used; if no `pipeline_stage_id` is provided, the Pipeline's first stage is used.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Opaque Deal ID with the `deal_` prefix.

items.docs: Return a single Deal by its `deal_` ID with full detail fields, including the Pipeline, current stage, and primary Contact (when set).

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Opaque Deal ID with the `deal_` prefix.

items.docs: Partially update a Deal by ID. Changing `pipeline_stage_id` must reference a stage in the Deal's current Pipeline; use the Pipelines endpoints to discover valid stage IDs.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Opaque Deal ID with the `deal_` prefix.

items.docs: Delete a Deal by ID. Associated Contact links are removed, but the underlying Contacts and Account remain.

items.docs: Return the set of Contacts currently associated with a Deal, along with which Contact is marked primary. Use `PUT /api/v1/deals/{deal_id}/contacts` to change the set.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Opaque Deal ID with the `deal_` prefix.

items.docs: Replace the complete set of Contacts associated with a Deal. The payload is a full replacement — Contacts not listed in `contact_ids` are unlinked from the Deal. `primary_contact_id`, if provided, must appear in `contact_ids`.
